note: Private RV park in Marion, one block east of I-57 exit 53. A small bar by the office sells beer, soda, pizza and ice. Some sites sit close together, and monthly guests share the park with overnighters. --Claude
summary: Operator page + Google read. $49.95 daily (weekly $270, monthly $690), 10% off for Good Sam/FMCA/Escapees members and veterans; 58 full-hookup sites, 27 pull-through, 50/30 A; showers, laundry, wifi. Under the $50 gate. Google 4.4/402. Note: 'swimming pool' dropped (page lists none). Phone 618-997-3484 (none stored); RV Life link should leave website.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): passes. Operator's posted daily rate $49.95 (undated page, read 2026-11-13; footer 'Copyright 2021'; the same figure was read 2026-10-16); its own 10% Good Sam/FMCA/Escapees/veterans discount makes $44.96. Not a directory Good Sam Park (isGsPark false). No gateway within 40 km (Gateway Arch NP 146 km). No mandatory per-night fees posted. A review 4 months ago calls the sites 'reasonably priced'.

GOOGLE: 4.4 stars, 402 reviews (read 2026-11-13). RV Life (stored) 4.5. One Tripadvisor 1-star 6 months ago complains of the manager's manner ('If you're a young couple planning to stay here for anywhere passed a day ...'); the Google reviews read are 4-5 stars from overnight travellers.

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) not seasonal-only; (2) nightly rate posted on the operator's own page ($49.95); (3) no homes/lots for sale; (4) nightly share: the page does not split the 58 sites, but 27 are pull-throughs and the newest Google reviews are one-night interstate stopovers and a tournament weekend - well over 1 in 10 nightly; (5) no approval wording. Monthly $690 is marketed and the page lists 'FREE & INCOME BASED CLINICS', which hints at some residents. Reads as an interstate overnight park with some monthly guests: keep.
